blocks.text: SCHEDULE: UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball tournament – first round MANILA, Philippines—Ateneo coach Louie Alas made one thing clear after the Blue Eagles’ 73-68 victory over Adamson in the UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball tournament Saturday at Mall of Asia Arena. Alas will almost always live and die with his guards. Led by Jared Bahay, Ateneo’s backcourt delivered as the Blue Eagles improved to 2-1. “Every time I build a team, the centerpiece is always a guard,” Alas said. “If you notice, ever since I started coaching, I have had a minimum of four to five guards, and I have a […]...
